elements.element: Vendor is the insuring party (not Customer)

errors and omissions) insurance of not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000)
cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than Five Million Dollars ($5,000,000)

reasons: The rule expected an insurance clause and none existed; the inserted 10.9 is a concise, self-contained provision that meets every preferred element (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to hosting and customer data, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request).
Insurer obligation is correctly directed at the Vendor (HDI) at its own expense, with the Company as recipient of certificates.

The additional one-year tail coverage period is a modest, customer-favourable adjunct to the maintenance obligation rather than a new exception or rewrite, so minimality is preserved; the official minimality gate also passes.

Untouched headings/counterparts language is intact, numbering follows 10.8 without conflict, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced (HDI, Company, Site, Confidential Information are existing terms).
